references.text: Kiriath-Baal, also called Kiriath-Jearim, is mentioned as part of Judah's border, confirming that this city was a boundary town between Judah and Benjamin.
Kiriath-Baal (Kiriath-Jearim) is listed as one of the cities in Judah's hill country, confirming its belonging to the tribe of Judah.
Kiriath-Jearim is mentioned as one of the Gibeonites' cities, providing background for the city's significance in the region.
Beth-Horon is mentioned in connection with Joshua's pursuit of the Amorite kings, showing the city's strategic location.
Beth-Horon is mentioned as a boundary point for the inheritance of Joseph's sons, showing the geographical connection with Benjamin's border.
Kiriath-Jearim was the place where the ark of the covenant was kept for twenty years after it was brought back from the Philistines.
Kiriath-Jearim is mentioned in connection with David bringing the ark of the covenant from there to Jerusalem.
